objective: Refine existing mobile materials and motion, add a flowing search perimeter, and repair confirmed bundle/Expo Go and mobile lifecycle errors
acceptance_criteria: Search outline follows the rounded border continuously and respects reduced motion/background state
Shared press feedback and panel transitions preserve actions, hit targets and scroll behavior
Material levels remain readable and avoid redundant nested backdrop sampling
Original 141 files and protected copies remain unchanged
SDK dependencies align and iOS/Android JavaScript exports complete
Missing optional speech module cannot crash Expo Go; browser speech support remains available
Runtime startup failures and rejected UI requests are handled visibly without unhandled rejections

decision.action: Refine presentation; align two Expo patch dependencies and repair optional-module and request lifecycle handling
evidence: Press controls use instantaneous scale switches
AppSurface resets opacity to 0.7 after panel commit
Existing Android blur workaround documents clipping
decision.risk: Layout and platform blur regressions require runtime checks

non_goals: Claim universal frame-rate or iOS device validation without evidence
